csv_project_name: DB for Alcantra Armory Road Paving Project
csv_agency: State of AK - Dept of Military & Veteran Affairs
csv_scope_of_work: The Department of Military and Veterans Affairs (DMVA) Construction and Facilities Management Office (CFMO) proposes to hire a Contractor to pave the new Alcantra Armory access road, driveway and parking lots. Prior to paving, the FMS/MEOC parking area needs to be graded and properly sloped to ensure surface water drains towards the woods instead of ponding in the center. This may require additional gravel material. The new access road needs grading and compaction. The old access road needs to be dug up and re-graded to correct water drainage. This area will be hydro-seeded. Existing pavement located at the Alcantra Armory parking lot could be removed and repaved if funding allows, if not paving will tie into existing pavement. Project shall meet all DOT and UFC requirements for multi-directional vehicle traffic.
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
